title: Sun-Dried Tomato and Basil Pesto Pasta Salad
changes_from_base: A sun-dried tomato, ricotta and pine-nut pesto replaces the vinaigrette, with torn basil and fresh cherry tomatoes instead of mozzarella and olives.
summary: Pasta coated in a rich, brick-red pesto of sun-dried tomatoes, ricotta and pine nuts, brightened with fresh cherry tomatoes and torn basil.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (1%)
ingredients.note: about 6.75 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

ingredients.item: oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, rinsed and blotted

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the pasta in the salted water a minute or two beyond al dente. Keep 120 ml of the water, then drain, rinse cold and shake dry.

steps.title: Blend the pesto
steps.text: Blend the sun-dried tomatoes, ricotta, pine nuts, cheese, garlic, oil, pepper and 60 ml pasta water to a thick, brick-red paste.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Toss the pasta with the pesto, adding a splash more pasta water if it clings in clumps.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fold in the cherry tomatoes and torn basil just before serving.

tips: Rinse the oil-packed tomatoes so the pesto is not greasy.
Add the basil at the last minute so it stays green.
Good for lunchboxes; it holds well for a day.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; loosen with a splash of water or oil and check the seasoning before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
